patches.title: Pick Visible Target First
patches.principle: If the target object is visible on an open surface, take it immediately without opening containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for a known object and it appears in the observation.

patches.title: Clean Then Direct Place
patches.principle: After cleaning the object at a sinkbasin, go straight to the destination and place it.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding a cleaned object and the destination is known.

patches.title: Open Only If Needed
patches.principle: Do not open closed containers unless the target object is not visible on any open surface.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target is not yet found and open surfaces have been checked.
